expected.fmt:
import expect_equal, expect_false from "@std/test/test.ms"

type Counter:
	count: Int
	label: String

type Outer:
	inner: Counter

fn tally(values: List[Int]) Int:
	var total = values.sum()
	return total

test "compound assignment on bindings":
	var number = 20
	number += 5
	number -= 3
	number *= 2
	number /= 4
	number %= 7

	var ratio = 1.5
	ratio *= 2.0

	var text = "a"
	text += "b"
	try expect_false(number != 4 or ratio != 3.0 or text != "ab")

test "right side groups as one operand":
	var number = 10
	number -= 4 - 1
	number *= 1 + 1
	try expect_equal(number, 14)

test "compound assignment on fields":
	var counter = Counter(1, "x")
	counter.count += 4
	counter.count *= counter.count
	counter.label += "y"

	var outer = Outer(counter.clone())
	outer.inner.count -= 5
	try expect_false(
		(
			counter.count != 25
			or counter.label != "xy"
			or outer.inner.count != 20
			or tally([1, 2, 3]) != 6
		)
	)

test "compound assignment in loops":
	var index = 0
	var total = 0

	while index < 5:
		total += index
		index += 1

	try expect_false(total != 10 or index != 5)
